messages.subject: Interactive tool for study design
parts:
'secrdesignapp' is a new Shiny app for designing spatial capture-recapture studies. Mostly it's an interactive interface to parts of the R package secrdesign.

You can run it directly in your web browser by clicking on this link:

www.stats.otago.ac.nz/secrdesignapp

Or you can find it on GitHub at

github.com/MurrayEfford/secrdesignapp

and run it from R on your own machine (see readme). Do read the Help. Feedback welcome.
